summary: AAPD opposes any E‑Rate sunset or restriction and rejects FCC proposals to regulate student screen time, arguing such measures would disproportionately harm students with disabilities. AAPD opposes screen‑time limits, competitive bidding, and urges expansion of eligible equipment to assistive technologies while calling for safeguards and impact assessment on disabled students.
